MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Space Performance + Bunny Speed

🚀🐰 Yes, Space Bunny  - which has topped global leaderboards with 200T+ tokens - was an earlier version of M3.1 Flash.

💰Redefining the performance economics of agentic AI. M3.1 Flash achieves frontier-level intelligence across key tasks such as Cowork (Automation-Bench: 62%; ALE: 30%), Coding (DeepSWE: 74%) and Visual Reasoning (BabyVision: 91%), at 1/3 the cost of M3 and 3x the speed.

API pricing (flat rate): $0.15 / $0.60 per 1M input/output tokens, with cache reads at $0.015 / 1M tokens.

Model weights will arrive on Oct 23.

API: http://platform.minimax.io
M Plan: https://www.minimax.io/m-plan
MiniMax Code for desktop: https://agent.minimax.io/download

links.text: Starting August 20, 2026, the paid APIs (Music Generation and Lyrics Generation) will no longer be available to new users; existing paying users can continue to use the current API services. The free music generation APIs (Music-3.0-free, Music-2.6-free, music-cover-free) will be discontinued.To experience or use music generation capabilities, please visit MiniMax Audio, or use the open-source MiniMax Music 3 model on Hugging Face.
